stemMd: A parcel weighs 0.85 kilograms. Packaging adds 120 grams. What is its total mass in grams?
explanationMd: Convert 0.85 kilograms to 850 grams, then add 120 grams. Both quantities must have the same unit before addition.

distractorRationale.a: Converts kilograms using the wrong scale.
distractorRationale.c: Adds kilograms to grams without converting.
